notes: Fewer than 3 large photographs: the left column loses its pictures one by one (step first, pair, then the opening) and the page thins out quickly; with only small photographs the opening has no left picture and the wordmark stands on the bare ground. A brand name whose last word is long makes the whole wordmark small; a one-word name gets a top-left mark only.
drops (as written): brand.logo (the name is set in type as a split wordmark)
drops (as written): place.spaces[].img unless the picture is large (small room pictures are not shown)
drops (as written): place.events after the first
drops (as written): palette.accent (the reference has no accent colour)
motif (as written): the client's own photographs (no made pictures; places)

photos_note: photos_large_min follows the contract's definition (>= 1600 wide) and is 0: the widest column is 896 px at 1440. What the template does need is 3 photographs that are not `small` and at least 700 px on the short side (the left column: opening, pair, step) — one of them upright or near square for the opening (it is held one screen high) — and 4 more at least 560 px wide for the right column (dishes do well there). With a menu list it takes 1–2 more dishes beside the list.

uses_when_present: ["place.menu", "place.events (first one, as the notice over the first screen)", "place.hours", "place.social", "place.notices", "steps / place.spaces (as text)", "plans", "faq", "links"]
